title: Subprocess timeouts of the tests that ran out in the Windows job scale with KB_TEST_TIMEOUT_FACTOR, which the job sets
goal: conftest.timeout_s(seconds) multiplies a test's subprocess timeout by KB_TEST_TIMEOUT_FACTOR (default 1, a number of at least 1, else the run stops with a message), the helpers behind the six timeouts of job 16825890140 use it (test_kb ask/hook and the no-claude kb_ask run, test_kbingest run, test_kb_mcp _embedded and _status, test_portability TestPowerShellLauncher.run) with their assertions unchanged, and kb-tests-windows sets KB_TEST_TIMEOUT_FACTOR 3 (the job ran about 3 times this host's 20 minutes); test_ci_config holds the variable, and a planted factor below 1 or not a number is refused.

run: timeout_factor or TestCiAllManual or TestPowerShellLauncher or kb_ask or kb_hook or embed_roots or drift
timeout_factor or TestCiAllManual or TestPowerShellLauncher or kb_ask or kb_hook or embed_roots or drift
